# conversation_chat_tool

> Send a chat message directly to an LLM conversation.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `conversation` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations (default) |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=conversation_chat_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Send a chat message directly to an LLM conversation. This tool allows MCP users to send messages
to conversations.

Without llm_model_id the user message is posted synchronously and returned.
With llm_model_id the LLM response generates ASYNCHRONOUSLY: the tool
enqueues the chat and returns immediately (async: true + job_id) without
the reply — poll the conversation's messages (newest first) to retrieve
it; large conversations can take a couple of minutes. Do not re-send the
same message while waiting: the chat is already running and re-sending
runs (and bills) it twice.

Cross-tenant: conversations shared with you from other tenants resolve
automatically — if the id isn't found in your tenant, it falls back to
your shared access (no parameter needed).

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `conversation_id` | integer | yes | ID of the conversation to send message to. |
| `message` | string | yes | The message content to send to the conversation. |
| `llm_model_id` | integer | no | LLM model ID to generate a response. If provided, triggers LLM response. If not provided, only adds the user message. |
| `include_shared` | boolean | no | DEPRECATED (accepted for back-compat, no longer needed): cross-tenant shared conversations now resolve automatically when the id is not found in your tenant. |

## Example

Post a message as yourself (synchronous, returns the posted message):

```json
{"name": "conversation_chat_tool", "arguments": {"conversation_id": 3870, "message": "@Ralph approved, proceed."}}
```

Post and ask a model to reply (asynchronous — returns `async: true` and a `job_id`):

```json
{"name": "conversation_chat_tool", "arguments": {"conversation_id": 3870, "message": "Summarise today's decisions", "llm_model_id": 12}}
```

## Gotchas

- **`message` is a plain string here.** Only raw `LlmMessage` rows use the `{role, content}` object.
- **Agents only act when mentioned.** Start the message with `@AgentName` if you want an agent in
  the conversation to react; an unmentioned message is a note nobody acts on.
- **Do not re-send while a reply is pending.** With `llm_model_id` the reply is generated in the
  background; poll the conversation's messages newest-first (`general_crud_tool`, model
  `LlmMessage`, filter `llm_conversation_id`, sort `created_at desc`). Re-sending runs — and bills — it twice.
- **Shared conversations resolve automatically** when the id is not in your own workspace;
  `include_shared` is accepted for back-compat but no longer needed.
